problem: NFL Rushing Yards and Receiving Yards card styling can collapse because the diagnosed presentation surfaces depend on Streamlit Markdown HTML/CSS transport.
root_cause: Step 1 froze STREAMLIT_MARKDOWN_PRESENTATION_TRANSPORT as the primary root cause. The affected Rushing V4 compact-card CSS/board and Receiving V13 card CSS rely on Markdown HTML transport, while the repository already has a certified st.html presentation precedent.
patch: Replace only the three diagnosed executable presentation calls with hardened Streamlit HTML transport: Rushing CSS to st.html, Rushing compact board to placeholder.html, and Receiving Step-13 CSS to st.html. Preserve the Step-1 Markdown signatures only as non-executable historical comments so the frozen diagnosis remains reproducible.
